notes.title: Ghost Town announcement! A new VR puzzle adventure from the developers of The Room series!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33026102/2c78d9e9304c9a14d21e4d40a1b8321b9a0b02e2.gif[/img]

We're thrilled to announce [i][u][b]Ghost Town[/b][/u][/i], our new single-player puzzle adventure VR game! We've been working away on this for the past 4/5 years so it's super exciting for us to finally show it off!

[i]London, 1983. Edith Penrose, a witch turned ghost hunter, is kept busy running her paranormal detective agency. But after her brother goes missing Edith must draw upon her wits & supernatural talents to unravel the mystery.[/i]
[i]
Step in to the boots of Edith and explore an array of atmospheric locations using your trusty torch to light your way. Use the unique physicality of VR to overcome tactile puzzles, activate sigils and move troubled spirits on to the next world.[/i]

The store page is live now, with an announcement trailer & a few screenshots to whet the appetite! And why not add [i][b]Ghost Town[/b][/i] to your wishlist while you're over there! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2496180/Ghost_Town/

notes.title: Puzzle box 'em up The Room celebrates its 10th anniversary with a series-wide sale next month
notes.content:
Puzzlebox solve ‘em up The Room entered the scene ten years ago, so developers Fireproof Games are celebrating the milestone anniversary with deep discounts across the entire slightly spooky series. From September 1st to September 14th, every single game in the puzzler series will enjoy a discount of up to 90% on Steam. Similarly big sales are taking place across the Nintendo eShop (until September 22nd) and the Google Play Store (until September 8th), if you wanted to take the lovely headscratchers on the go. Or to the comfort of your own bed.

Read more

notes.title: The Room Three - RELEASE TOMORROW!!
notes.content:
The Room Three is available on Steam as of tomorrow! We're all set to hit the release button and can't wait to get it in to your hands!

If you didn't know already - our Coming Soon Page is live now and from tomorrow, this is where you can purchase the game:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/456750/The_Room_Three

The Room Three has received a complete visual overhaul for PC. As the game is significantly larger than the others in the series, this was quite an undertaking! Check out our [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LPEkMcjeOgg]comparison video[/url] to get a glimpse of how every asset and environment has been re-built, re-textured and re-lit to bring the mysterious world of The Room to life.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33026102/b326270ff1aab4209b92a47a13634dc3e4f2b963.jpg[/img]
Continuing the story from The Room Two, your obsessive search for the Null results with being lured to ‘Grey Holm’, a mysterious mansion located on a remote island. You'll need all your puzzle-solving abilities on hand to navigate a series of trials devised by a mysterious figure known only as “The Craftsman”.

Grey Holm is home to many secrets, some of which may help you to alter your fate. It's up to you to discover them...

- Fireproof Games Team

notes.title: The Room Three polishes up and puzzles out a November release date
notes.content:

notes.title: Wot I Think: The Room Two
notes.content:
“Presumably we can hope for The Room Two [official site] on PC some time in 2016,” I presciently wrote when reviewing The Room back in 2014. I am a truly great soothsayer. And the reason it takes this long for the hit mobile games to reach the PC is because developers Fireproof are remaking them from the ground up, to survive the transition from weeny phone screens to looming monitors. The result is, I’m pleased to report, splendid. If remarkably gloomy. Here’s wot I think:

notes.title: OUT NOW! The Room Two: PC Edition
notes.content:
Following the release of 'The Room' on PC in 2014, we're proud to announce 'The Room Two' is OUT NOW on PC.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/425580

The Room Two continues the time-spanning journey of its predecessor while significantly expanding its unique puzzle gameplay. Follow a trail of cryptic letters from an enigmatic scientist known only as “AS” into a compelling world of challenging mystery and tactile exploration.
Development on this fully-enhanced HD version of The Room Two began shortly after the mobile release of The Room Three late in 2015 and has involved creating wholly new environments for each level as well as rebuilding and re-texturing every asset in the game.

Trailer here:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_wmRQl-huMo
